name: The Origin Kathu-Patong
shortDescription: Studio, one and two bedroom condominiums of 25 to 48 sqm between Kathu and Patong, by Origin Property.
description:
The Origin Kathu-Patong is a condominium by Origin Property on the Kathu side of the Kathu-Patong corridor. Agent listings describe studio, one-bedroom and two-bedroom units with a built-up area of about 25 to 48 sqm.

Foreign buyers can own units as freehold, within the 49% foreign quota of the building. Agents report completion either in late 2025 or mid 2026, so ask us to confirm the current construction status.

Prices start from roughly 2.3 million baht in agent listings. Message us on WhatsApp for current availability.
